The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm. On it are a small braised lamb shank, mostly bone with a little meat, and about 6 thin fries.

The shank is roughly 10 cm long. I estimate about 60 g of edible meat, though the whole piece with bone might weigh around 120 g. At roughly 250 kcal per 100 g for the meat, that is about 150 kcal.

The 6 fries weigh about 5 g each, so about 40 g in total, which comes to roughly 120 kcal.

That gives a total of about 270 kcal. For mass I counted the meat and fries but only part of the bone, giving about 120 g.
